about: Flaky tests skipped on CI: each a flake id, its owner lane and an expiry at most 24 h on, at most 3 at once. scripts/quarantine.mjs --add writes an entry and prints the test's skip; --check (and scripts/quarantine.test.mjs, on every pull request) fails once one expires.

tests.name: a notice and its record are one write: the outbox holds the end and the wait it queued of each run; the same moment again queues nothing, here or in the next server
tests.why: Timed out waiting for local webhook deliveries on two PRs that don't touch webhooks, 11-05: serve/runs-list-trigger (pi-1-2 1.2.0, 6, 04:57Z, 'waited for the new end sent') and #1601 (test 24.21.0, any-6, 20 s on hook.got.length === 3); 316 ms locally. Both after the day's webhook changes (#1640, #1611): the owner rules out a regression first, then fixes.
